notes: S3-FIX2 (decision 2026-11-18 #2): a valid zip container without manifest.blobs also holds the zero-data entry records/x, which carries the DOS directory attribute (0x10) and whose name does not end with '/'. Only the final '/' makes a directory entry (§11.9 rule 4), so records/x is a zero-byte file in records/ that manifest.records does not list (§11.6): E_MANIFEST_RECORD_EXTRA at the records listing, records is [] (narrow review medium-1 N1). The Rust verifier called the entry a directory entry and accepted this zip before the fix.
